name: Lights in the Sky
source: Lights in the Sky is the story of Rising Star’s journey to find her cutie mark. As a farm filly, Rising Star tries hard to fulfill the responsibilities given to her by her older sister, Heartland. But an opportunity arises where she finds that her heart’s desire may rest outside the boundaries of the Star Fields family farm. Rising Star will be put to the test as she is forced to decide between adherence to her sister’s wishes or the yearning to follow her own dreams.
translation: 《天空之光》讲述了闪耀星寻找可爱标志的旅程。作为一匹农场小马，闪耀星努力履行姐姐心兰交给她的责任。然而，一个机会出现了，她发现自己内心的愿望或许并不在星野家族农场的边界之内。闪耀星将受到考验，被迫在遵从姐姐的愿望与追寻自己梦想的渴望之间作出选择。
